visualCharacteristics.purpose: API-driven doctor search results: result cards (name, service tags Aligners/Braces/Retainers with tooltip, distance, address, phone link, Google Maps driving instructions), pagination and a results count, beside a sticky Google Map with a marker and info window per doctor. Renders nothing until the page URL carries a search
visualCharacteristics.layout: two columns from 900px (results left, sticky map right); stacked below with a 'Doctor map' toggle; list takes full width when no Google Maps key is configured

contentPattern.structure: key | value rows: source (doctors API URL, default https://www.suresmile.com/api/location/doctors); no-results (heading + message, e.g. '**We're sorry**' / 'We couldn't find any SureSmile doctors in this area. Try expanding your search.'); results-label ('{count} results for'); per-page (20). Optional rows: maps-api-key (Google Maps JS key; enables map and address geocoding), map-id, geocode (on/off), directions-label ('Driving instructions'), map-label ('Doctor map'), services-tooltip, aligners, braces, retainers, previous-label, next-label, pagination-label, loading-label, location-label. A single-cell first row is read as the source URL. Reads ?lat=&lng=&radius= or ?address=&radius= from the page URL and calls GET {source}?lat=&lng=&radius=&page=&per_page=&unit=mi
contentPattern.interactive: fetches results, pagination, tooltip, Google Map markers and info windows, mobile map toggle

suitableFor: doctor, provider or store locator results pages fed by a lat/lng/radius JSON API
the results half of a search-locator hand-off page
notSuitableFor: site content search over a query index (use search)
